titulo: Om Mani Padme Hum, on a Tuesday
caption:
Om Mani Padme Hum, in four ordinary moments.
The meanings follow the 14th Dalai Lama: om, body, speech and mind; mani, the jewel of compassion; padme, the lotus of wisdom, “not sullied by the faults of mud”; hum, the two as one.
Link in bio.
by NMR
#ommanipadmehum #mantra #buddhism

alt.1: yellow field, Cella saying “Me? Very spiritual.” in a speech bubble. Your Tuesday already contains Om Mani Padme Hum. Four parts. Four tiny moments.
alt.2: coral field, Cella with her eyes shut, next to a meeting table, saying “Great idea!” in a speech bubble. Om: body, speech and mind. Speech: “great idea.” Face: no. Mind: lunch.
alt.3: green field, Cella texting “I’m here.” next to a phone. Mani: the jewel: compassion, as a method. Two words to a friend on a bad day. Cheapest jewel you own.
alt.4: lavender field, a pile of white chat bubbles on the right, Cella calm on the left with her eyes closed. Padme: the lotus: wisdom, not sullied by mud. The group chat is on fire. Read all of it. Replied to none.
alt.5: pink field, Cella saying “No. And I love you.” in one speech bubble. Hum: method and wisdom, as one. Kind and true, same message. You keep picking just one.
alt.6: the four parts as a list. Om Mani Padme Hum, per the 14th Dalai Lama: Send it to the friend who says “I’m fine” with their shoulders. 1. Om · body, speech, mind, same room. 2. Mani · the jewel. “I’m here.” 3. Padme · the lotus. Mud, unsullied. 4. Hum · kind and true, together.
